everything but A|fail|fix-b-pause.py,fix-c-calendar.py

everything but C|fail|fix-a-completion.py,fix-b-pause.py
all three (the reference)|pass|fix-a-completion.py,fix-b-pause.py,fix-c-calendar.py
# ALTERNATIVE VALID SOLUTIONS (a different RULE, or a different mechanism): none of these may be spec-red.
A alternative: an unrun or non-independent review is missing corroboration|pass|alt-a-review-pending.py,fix-b-pause.py,fix-c-calendar.py
A alternative: a claimed_complete MISSION verdict is a trust shortfall|pass|alt-a-mission-claim.py,fix-b-pause.py,fix-c-calendar.py
B alternative: a finer-than-ppm fraction is REFUSED as configuration|pass|fix-a-completion.py,alt-b-refuse.py,fix-c-calendar.py
B alternative: the fraction compared as an EXACT decimal rational|pass|fix-a-completion.py,alt-b-exact.py,fix-c-calendar.py
C alternative: T24:00 kept as end-of-day midnight, date checked only|pass|fix-a-completion.py,fix-b-pause.py,alt-c-allow-2400.py
C alternative: wall-clock round trip through Date.UTC|pass|fix-a-completion.py,fix-b-pause.py,alt-c-roundtrip.py
first alternatives together|pass|alt-a-review-pending.py,alt-b-refuse.py,alt-c-allow-2400.py
second alternatives together|pass|alt-a-mission-claim.py,alt-b-exact.py,alt-c-roundtrip.py
